data.reason: One fixed follow-up round covering initial tail flags and all-AA controls; strengthened host-wide compiler/test inventory. Original runs and flags are retained, not replaced.
data.stop_rule: Run each listed matrix exactly once; do not repeat until a preferred result appears. Preserve any failure and every quantile/outlier.
data.noise_rule: Unchanged: for each quantile, max(B0 repeated span, 5% B0 median) + 0.1ms. Exact color/resolved depth, no widened tolerance.

predetermined_followup_plan.analysis: Initial and host-isolated follow-up cases remain separated by matrix name; no pooled replacement of initial tail flags.

data.derivation: read-only raw offline log derivation; no rerender

transition_schedule.expired: synthetic light removed; same inputs as none, not a timer expiration replay
transition_schedule.swept_camera: camera yaw changes by .05 degrees per loop frame, lights remain anchored to seed camera

shader_mapping_provenance.basis: source-inferred mapping, not runtime program ID measurement; matched raw input signatures are measured
shader_mapping_provenance.runtime_brush: general program; extra static-world programs not created for brush resources

resource_observations.measurement_scope: timed benchmark runs only; separate memory-only observer records, if present, are reported independently
resource_observations.note: These bounded allocation/upload counters are not a measured resident-memory high-water value.

limitations: Controlled synthetic lights, not a replay of historical dynamic state.
Depth comparison is resolved world depth, not per-sample MSAA depth.
Cold CPU render includes resource preparation and driver work; it does not isolate shader compilation.
No GPU timing is claimed when diagnostic queries are disabled.

data.measurement_scope: OS cumulative process peak counters observed through the last successful live sample; the unsampled final interval may be missed. Not guaranteed full-lifetime peak.

memory_observations.cold_start: per_run cold_render_cpu_ms includes resource creation and driver work; it does not isolate shader compilation
memory_observations.cold_penalty: initial paired matrices show approximately 17-22ms higher median first render; host-isolated all-AA follow-up medians 50.79105 to 52.0287ms and far8 51.7771 to 52.2281ms. Absolute-round change and driver-cache contribution are not causally established. Keep rounds separate.
